about:
Based in West Greenwich, Rhode Island, Gonzos Custom Shirts and Signs operates as a custom print and vinyl wrap shop serving both individual and commercial clients. The company does not publicly disclose its founding year or ownership structure.

The shop provides a range of customization services including vinyl vehicle wraps, direct-to-film (DTF) gang sheet printing for heat transfers, poster and banner printing, and custom apparel such as screen-printed t-shirts, hoodies, and embroidered hats. Production is handled in-house with capabilities for both small and large runs, though exact capacity and headcount are not disclosed.

Customers include vehicle owners seeking personalized wraps, businesses and organizations ordering branded apparel and promotional signage, and individuals creating custom prints. The company markets itself as a one-stop-shop for customization, though specific industry verticals are not detailed.

Gonzos emphasizes convenience and durability, advertising a 'no refunds needed' guarantee on installed vinyl wraps and tailored fitment for specific vehicle models. Volume discounts are offered on apparel orders of five or more shirts, and promotional pricing of 50 percent off is frequently applied to posters, banners, and DTF gang sheets.
